fullTextZH: 但是有时候吵架也会有想过
fullTextEN: But sometimes when we argue, I have thought about it.

fullTextZH: 如果我们真的离婚会怎么样
fullTextEN: What would happen if we really got divorced?

fullTextZH: 现在有一点能理解爸爸妈妈的想法
fullTextEN: Now I can somewhat understand my parents' thoughts.

fullTextZH: 因为离婚对中国人来说
fullTextEN: Because divorce for Chinese people

fullTextZH: 离婚不是两个人的事情
fullTextEN: Divorce is not just between two people.
It might be two families.
His parents.
My parents.
And our child.

fullTextZH: 甚至我们的朋友都有关系
fullTextEN: Even our friends are involved.

fullTextZH: 所以确实是一件很难的事情
fullTextEN: So it really is a difficult thing.
